body:
Stdlib, stylised search over a planar arm's joint count, link lengths and mount with the IK controller tuned in the loop, against a fixed three-link body at equal cost. Shelf task: 0.95 vs 0.26 held-out success; long reach: no gain. Kinematic only (no MuJoCo); all costs assumed. Companion to #510 (`osrobot-morph`, another run, same milestone); different slug and method. 9 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok.
